name: Status report 2026-11-18 09:40 UTC — root cause found: the agents' own bookkeeping is the pending change
description:
#TL; DR;
**Status: AT RISK — but for the first time the two blockers have one root cause and one small fix.**

The gate that is supposed to judge every change on this project has been red for three reasons that looked unrelated: no test suite declared, ~1000 false security alerts, and a pending change nobody approved. Measured this shift, the 25 files waiting for approval are **24 files of the AI agents' own runtime bookkeeping plus 1 documentation file**. The repository tracks that bookkeeping (`.gitignore` only covers `tmp/`), so every agent shift dirties the workspace and floods the security scanner with timestamps and task IDs. **One reversible commit — stop tracking runtime state — removes both problems.** It now has an owner and a date (20 Nov).
The nearest thing to a decision, and the only one that expires tomorrow, is **approving that one documentation file and explicitly not the 24 noise files** (decide by **19 Nov 08:00 UTC**).

## 1. Summary
Goal of the workstream: make the QA/security gate of `codx-docs` produce a verdict that means something, so documentation deliveries are judged by evidence instead of being blocked (or waved through) by an unreliable gate.
Business outcome: predictable release of documentation to customers; a gate management can trust enough to act on. No customer-facing feature is affected, no external party is involved, nothing is revenue-blocking today.

## 2. Scope
**In scope (sprint `QA gate hardening (18-21 Nov 2026)`):** gate root decision (done) · suite declaration · `tests.no-suite` cleared · control-plane noise removed from the gate · platform-repo gating decision · reviewer report made attributable.
**Out of scope:** host PDF engine (`c2dc4ded`, 25 Nov / 1 Dec, internal tooling only — documented in `delivery-contract.md`) · any change to product code.

## 3. Increment plan
| M | Deliverable | Owner | Date | Deployable? | Demoable? | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | Gate root = `docs/` (option C), recorded in `delivery-contract.md` | ProjectManager | 2026-11-18 | yes | yes — the contract text is the artefact | **Done** (`b776e9a7`) — verified this shift by reading the committed diff |
| M2 | `qa_policy` schema verified + docs suite declared | software_developer | 2026-11-20 | yes | yes — paste `qa_plan()` + `qa_run_tests()` | **On hold, critical path** (`e684ce5c`) — needs a human with config write access |
| M6 | **NEW** — volatile `.codx` state untracked (`.gitignore` + `git rm --cached`) | software_developer | 2026-11-20 | yes | yes — `git status` clean after an agent shift + `security_audit(".codx")` = 0 findings | **To do** (`8909f356`), wake 20 Nov 09:30 |
| M3 | `tests.no-suite` (HIGH) cleared, gate returns a real verdict | software_developer | 2026-11-21 | yes | yes — gate output on a real change | **On hold** (`3fb379ae`), wake 20 Nov 09:00 |
| M4 | Platform repo (`api/`+`client/`) gating decision | management + software_developer | decision by 2026-11-20 | n/a | yes — one-screen options | **On hold** (`42c8d580`), wake 20 Nov 10:00 |
| M5 | CISO reviewer: aggregable, attributable severity (Finding B) | software_developer + ciso | 2026-11-22 | yes | yes — short, attributable report | **On hold** (`19883bdd`), wake 20 Nov 08:51 |
| M7 | Host PDF engine (optional) | software_developer | 2026-12-01 | n/a | no — internal tooling | **On hold**, low (`c2dc4ded`), wake 25 Nov |

All seven rows answer "yes/yes" or are explicitly marked n/a with a reason.

## 4. Dependencies & critical path
`M2 (suite declared)` → `M3 (no-suite cleared)` → gate can judge a change. **M2 is the critical path and it is blocked on human access, not on work.**
`M6 (noise untracked)` is independent of M2/M3 and runs in parallel; it is the cheapest win in the sprint.
`M5` depends on M6 for its demo (a report is only attributable once the noise is gone).
`M4` is a decision, answerable in parallel.

## 5. Risks
| Risk | Impact | Prob. | Mitigation | Owner | Needs decision? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Approving the pending 25-file change wholesale | security gate stays permanently red; approvals normalise noise | high | Approve `delivery-contract.md` only; reject the `.codx` churn (comment added on `a8be6182` this shift) | management | **yes — expires 19 Nov** |
| Nobody has write access to `.codx/project.json` | M2/M3 stall indefinitely; gate never runs a suite | high | `e684ce5c` carries the exact 2-line JSON for a human to paste | ProjectManager | **yes** |
| `docs:build` is a build, not a test suite | a "green" gate that proves nothing → false confidence | medium | M3 acceptance must show what the suite asserts; add a link/version check in the same card | software_developer | yes |
| Option C leaves `api/` + `client/` ungated | platform regressions undetected | medium | M4 decision card | management | **yes** |
| Agent shifts keep dirtying the tree while M6 is pending | the QA verdict card reopens every day | high | M6 lands 20 Nov; until then measure before deciding, as done today | software_developer | no |

## 6. Decisions needed from management
1. **Approve/reject the pending change (card `a8be6182`) — decide by 2026-11-19 08:00 UTC.** Options: (a) approve `delivery-contract.md` alone, leave the `.codx` churn unapproved until M6 *[recommended]*; (b) approve all 25 files — keeps the gate red and entrenches noise; (c) reject all — loses the decision record that closed M1. **Recommendation: (a).** Cost: 2 minutes.
2. **Make `qa_policy` writable — decide by 2026-11-20 08:00 UTC.** (a) a human pastes the JSON from `e684ce5c` *[recommended, 2 min, no code risk]*; (b) grant a profile write access to the control plane. **Recommendation: (a).**
3. **Platform-repo gating (`42c8d580`) — decide by 2026-11-20 10:00 UTC.** (a) keep option C here and open a separate gating card on the parent repo *[recommended — one gate per repository is the only truthful configuration]*; (b) widen this project to the monorepo.

## 7. Next demo & checkpoint
**Next checkpoint: 2026-11-20, 08:00 UTC.** What management sees, in order: (1) `git status` clean right after an agent shift — M6; (2) `qa_plan()` + `qa_run_tests()` returning a real verdict — M2/M3; (3) the CISO report in one screen with an attributable top finding — M5.
Needed to run it: decisions 2 and 3 applied. Nothing else is on the demo's critical path.

## 8. Demo script (M6, first increment ready — ~3 minutes)
1. Show today's `git status`: 25 files pending.
2. Show the breakdown: 24 of them are `.codx/` bookkeeping written by the agents, 1 is `delivery-contract.md`.
3. Run an agent shift, then `git status` again → the bookkeeping no longer appears.
4. Run `security_audit(".codx")` → 0 high-entropy findings (from 1058).
5. Restore check: the autonomy worker still starts (the files were untracked, not deleted).
**Question for management:** should task cards themselves (`.codx/tasks/**`) stay in git as an audit trail, or is that data for the tool, not the repository?

## Board changes made this shift
- Created **`8909f356` (M6)** — IT team / To Do, sprint, owner `software_developer`, due 20 Nov, wake 20 Nov 09:30, high.
- **`19883bdd`** — added to the sprint (it was outside the plan), priority raised to high, status `onhold`, re-slice comment posted (Finding A → M6, Finding B stays).
- **`a8be6182`** — comment added with today's measurement (25 files, 24 = `.codx`) and the recommended split, ahead of its 19 Nov wake. Due date and wake unchanged.
- **`8a7bac2b`** (previous shift report) — status `todo` while sitting in *Working* → moved to *Done*, status `done`, progress 100.
- Deliberately **no file written** this shift: adding another pending file before the 19 Nov approval decision would enlarge the very diff management is being asked to judge. The report therefore lives on the board, not in the repo.

- Created **`8909f356` (M6)** — IT team / To Do, sprint, owner `software_developer`, due 20 Nov, wake 20 Nov 09:30, high.

- **`a8be6182`** — comment added with today's measurement (25 files, 24 = `.codx`) and the recommended split, ahead of its 19 Nov wake. Due date and wake unchanged.

**Addendum (same shift, second pass) — one defect in my own plan found and fixed.**

The plan published above assumed M6 (`8909f356`) could simply run at its wake. It cannot run unguarded: **M6 mutates the same working tree that `a8be6182` is asking management to approve on 19 Nov.** A milestone that invalidates the review it depends on is exactly the kind of sequencing error this board exists to prevent.

Actions taken:
1. `8909f356` (M6) now carries three explicit paths decided at its wake: **A** approval granted → full `git rm --cached`; **B** approval still pending → `.gitignore` append only, untracking deferred (increment still demoable, 1058→0 explicitly *not* claimed); **C** rejected → card returns to PM, only the `ignore_paths` branch of `19883bdd` remains. Written constraint: never delete `.codx` from disk, never touch `.codx/tasks/**` content, never change the scanner policy.
2. `f6d1855e` (demo, 21 Nov) now adapts its agenda to whichever path M6 took, and must label the slot with the path — no presenting a `.gitignore` commit as if it were the false-positive fix.
3. Load warning added to the demo card: **five cards wake on 20 Nov between 08:00 and 10:00** (`e684ce5c` 08:00, `19883bdd` 08:51, `3fb379ae` 09:00, `8909f356` 09:30, `42c8d580` 10:00). Any silence by 20 Nov 18:00 must be chased that evening, not discovered at the demo.

No change to the TL;DR verdict: **AT RISK**, decision #1 (approve `delivery-contract.md`, reject the 24 `.codx` noise files) still expires **19 Nov 08:00 UTC**.

**Addendum 2 (same shift, third pass) — the increment plan above was missing a milestone.**

The 7-row plan listed **M5** as work in the sprint. It was not: `list_tasks(board="IT team", query="M5")` returned only the demo card, and the demo's step 3 pointed at a milestone with no card, no owner and no date. Corrected in this pass:

| Milestone | Card | Owner (profile) | Date | Deployable | Demoable | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| M1 decision record | committed in `delivery-contract.md` | ProjectManager | done 18 Nov | n/a (doc) | yes | **done** |
| M2 declare QA suite | `e684ce5c` | human (needs `.codx/project.json` write) | 20 Nov 08:00 | yes | yes | blocked — human paste |
| M3 verify the gate runs | `3fb379ae` | `software_developer` | 20 Nov 09:00 | yes | yes | onhold, correctly sequenced after M2 |
| M4 platform gating | `42c8d580` | **decision: management** (assignee set to ProjectManager; `profiles` could not be replaced by the tool) | 21 Nov | after decision | yes (as a decision) | onhold |
| M5 reviewer attribution | **`17efa3eb` (new)** | `software_developer` | 20 Nov, wake 11:00 | yes | yes | todo |
| M6 untrack `.codx` noise | `8909f356` | `software_developer` | 20 Nov 09:30 | yes | yes | todo, 3 paths defined |
| Sprint demo | `f6d1855e` | ProjectManager | 21 Nov 08:30 | n/a | is the demo | todo |

Consequences for the numbers in the plan above: the sprint holds **11 cards**, not 10. The 20 Nov load is now **six** wakes between 08:00 and 11:00 (`e684ce5c` 08:00 · `19883bdd` 08:51 · `3fb379ae` 09:00 · `8909f356` 09:30 · `42c8d580` 10:00 · `17efa3eb` 11:00); none of them is mine to run, but if any goes silent the demo presents a missing slot — so the chase deadline of 20 Nov 18:00 written into `f6d1855e` now covers six owners, not five.

Two tool limitations recorded so they are not re-attempted: `project_manager(action="update_task")` **ignores `profiles`** (only `assignees` changed on `42c8d580`), and `create_task` writes a **blank status** (fixed on `17efa3eb` with a follow-up `update_task`). Board truthfulness therefore cannot be enforced through the create call alone.

Verdict unchanged: **AT RISK**. Decision #1 (`a8be6182`, approve only `delivery-contract.md`, reject the 24 machine-generated files) still expires **19 Nov 08:00 UTC**; decision #2 (`e684ce5c`) is still the only thing between the team and a measurable gate.

**Addendum 3 (same shift, fourth pass) — one line of the published table was wrong; corrected on the board, not just here.**

The wake table in addendum 2 listed `19883bdd` at **20 Nov 08:51**. That was the CISO agent's own setting and it was **39 minutes before** M6 (`8909f356`, 09:30) lands the fix and **2h09m before** M5 (`17efa3eb`, 11:00) reports the after-state. The card that measures the 1058 findings would therefore have run before anything it measures, produced "still broken", and **no post-fix number would have existed for the 21 Nov demo**.

Correction applied: `19883bdd` wake → **20 Nov 12:00**, due 20 Nov, with an explicit measure-don't-fix instruction on the card.

**Corrected 20 Nov sequence (one agent shift each — six wakes in four hours is the load risk, unchanged):**

| time (UTC) | card | who | what |
|---|---|---|---|
| 08:00 | `e684ce5c` | human | paste `qa_policy` suite declaration (**M2**) |
| 09:00 | `3fb379ae` | software_developer | verify the gate actually runs (**M3**) |
| 09:30 | `8909f356` | software_developer | **M6** untrack volatile `.codx` (3 defined paths) |
| 10:00 | `42c8d580` | ProjectManager | **M4** escalate only, no auto-choice |
| 11:00 | `17efa3eb` | software_developer | **M5** reviewer attribution |
| **12:00** | **`19883bdd`** | **dev + ciso** | **measure the result: before → after, verdict, `path:line`** |
| 21 Nov 08:30 | `f6d1855e` | ProjectManager | sprint demo, 11 cards |

**Also done this pass:** the runnable **demo script** is now on `f6d1855e` — exact commands per step, the data to use (break one line in `delivery-contract.md` for the live fail→pass), the expected output, the fixed wording for every not-demonstrated case, and the three decisions to be signed in the room. The earlier agenda said *what* to show; the script says *how*, so the review runs without me improvising.

**Unchanged and still the only expiry:** decision #1 (`a8be6182`) — by **19 Nov 08:00 UTC** approve `delivery-contract.md` and explicitly reject the 24 machine-generated files. Nothing else needs management before then.
